name: omnistream-for-codex
description: A source-only Codex simulation control studio for a windowless local NVIDIA Omniverse Kit runtime over WebRTC.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, animate, simulate and debug the open Omniverse scene.
interface.longDescription: A viewport-first control studio for the current scene of a managed windowless Kit runtime: inspect USD, preview/apply reversible physics and animation changes, run bounded simulations, observe live telemetry and diagnose scene structure. NVIDIA components remain external. Physical capabilities depend on the configured Kit application.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open OmniStream. Inspect my currently open managed Omniverse scene without reloading it; use live telemetry and reversible scene patches to configure, run and debug the requested animation or simulation.
